def mvcc.bucketKeyOk (k : GoString) : Prop :=
  ∃ r rest, k = mvcc.revBytes r false ++ rest ∧ rest.length ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z r.main ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z r.sub
